Classify and Validate Whether an Endpoint Is Strictly Local / Loopback

Source: R/container.R
is_loopback_endpoint.Rd

Strictly parses a runtime endpoint URL and verifies that it targets only the local loopback interface (127.0.0.1, localhost, or [::1]), a local Unix domain socket (unix:///...), or the built-in offline mock runtime (mock://offline). Remote hosts, LAN IP addresses, wildcard binds (0.0.0.0), userinfo spoofing (http://127.0.0.1@evil.com), and unsupported schemes are rejected.

Usage

is_loopback_endpoint(endpoint)

Arguments

endpoint

Character scalar URL or an airgap_runtime object.

Value

Logical scalar TRUE if the endpoint is strictly local/loopback, FALSE otherwise.

Examples

is_loopback_endpoint("http://127.0.0.1:11434")
#> [1] TRUE
is_loopback_endpoint("http://localhost:8000/v1")
#> [1] TRUE
is_loopback_endpoint("https://api.openai.com/v1")
#> [1] FALSE
